question: Does any threshold relaxation of the s020 seed-6 filter let the 5 known basin-pool candidates (2 truth + 3 twin) survive?
hypothesis: Relaxing the geo/align thresholds admits the truth-basin and twin-basin candidates.
narrative_md: Pure post-process re-categorising the cached 432k seed-6 pool at 4 relaxation levels. Decisive NO: every level rejects all 5 basin candidates because they score align <= 0.429 (3/7 bright peaks) and the lowest tested threshold is 0.5. Sharpens the s020 diagnosis from 'thresholds too strict' to 'IC granularity (30deg phi steps) too coarse' — not a hyperparameter fix. Also corrected an s020 mis-recorded count (28,690 not ~1864).
